title: Suraj chiragh hai, chaand nahi (faceless, 67.5 s)

lines.line: Suraj abhi bujh jaaye, toh chaand bhi lagbhag *aath minute* mein bujh jaayega.

options.visual: 0.0 s: NASA full Moon fills the upper two-thirds, the Sun (NASA SDO) burning at the left edge, a flat switch beside it set to ON, the Moon drifting slowly. 0.8 s 'bujh': the switch flicks, the Sun goes black at once, the Moon still lit. 1.9 s 'aath minute': an 08:20 timer slams in under the Moon and races down. 2.9 s 'bujh jaayega': 00:00, the Moon goes dark in 0.3 s, a faint grey rim left.
options.sound: low hum from frame 0, hard click on the switch, fast ticks under the timer, silence when the Moon goes out
options.why: The research storyboard: four hard beats in 3 s, the surprise (Moon goes out too) is the picture itself, reads with sound off.

options.visual: 0.0 s: Sun top, Moon bottom, a thin beam of light already running between them. 0.8 s: the Sun collapses to black. 1.9 s: the last light travels down the beam with an '8 min 20 s' counter riding on it. 2.9 s: the light reaches the Moon and the Moon dies.
options.sound: hum, a low thud on the Sun, a rising tone along the beam, cut to silence
options.why: Shows why it takes 8 minutes (light travel), but the beam is thinner at thumbnail size.

options.visual: 0.0 s: a real night photo of a full Moon over a city skyline; 0.8 s: the sky flashes darker; 1.9 s: 08:20 timer at the top; 2.9 s: the Moon in the photo blacks out.
options.sound: city night ambience, click, ticks, silence
options.why: Feels real, but needs a free-licence skyline photo and the Sun is never seen, so 'suraj bujh' is not shown in 1.5 s.

lines.line: Kyunki chaand ki apni roshni hi nahi hai. Wo bas suraj ki roshni *lautata* hai.

options.visual: 3.5 s: hard cut, the dark Moon alone on night ground; 'No light of its own' sets in serif. 5.0 s: the Sun is back at the left edge, a broad sheet of amber light crosses and lights the Moon's left half. 6.1 s 'lautata': the light scatters off the Moon toward the viewer (soft rays reaching the lens).
options.sound: soft whoosh on the cut, warm swell as the light arrives
options.why: Answers the hook at once and plants the amber = own light rule.

options.visual: NASA Moon photo top; a small Sun-Moon-Earth diagram below with arrows.
options.why: Clear but a textbook look.

options.visual: NASA LRO close-up of the grey Moon surface, raking sunlight sweeping across the craters.
options.why: Beautiful, but 'lautata' is not visible.

lines.line: Isi baat pe ek forward ghoomta hai: Quran ne 1400 saal pehle hi bata diya tha.

options.visual: A generic chat forward (no app name, no real account) slides up over the lit Moon: 'Forwarded many times' on top, then the message: '1400 years ago the Quran said the Moon's light is reflected.' On '1400' the number is marked.
options.text: 1400 years ago the Quran said the Moon's light is reflected.
options.why: The viewer has seen this forward; it names the claim we check.

options.visual: '1400 years' huge in serif, the claim below.
options.why: Clean, but without the forward it loses the 'you have seen this' feeling.

lines.line: Saboot, Surah Nuh ki ye aayat: "wa ja'alal qamara fihinna nura, wa ja'alash shamsa siraja".

options.visual: 71:16 in Amiri Quran on the night ground, set in two halves: the moon half in ivory, the sun half below; each half lights as it is recited, نورا and سراجا underlined as spoken. Captions hidden.
options.why: Lets the Ayah be the hero; recitation is never captioned from Whisper.

options.visual: The Ayah over a dimmed full Moon.
options.why: Pretty, but lower contrast for the Arabic.

lines.line: Chaand ko banaya *nur*. Aur suraj ko *siraj*, yaani jalta hua chiragh.

options.visual: Top: the Moon with نور (nur) and 'light'. Bottom: a real clay oil lamp burning (free-licence photo/footage), سراج (siraj) in amber with 'a burning lamp'. The lamp flame flickers.
options.text: nur, light / siraj, a burning lamp
options.sound: soft tick per word, a match-strike on the flame
options.why: Shows the real object behind the word siraj.

options.visual: nur and siraj side by side in serif with meanings.
options.why: Simpler, no real lamp.

lines.line: English translation mein likha hai, a "reflected" light. Par ruko, reflected *bracket* mein hai.

options.layout: full-screen pull quote on a paper-tinted page
options.visual: The Saheeh International line set as type: 'And made the moon therein a [reflected] light'. 'reflected' marked as spoken; on 'bracket' a hand-drawn ring closes around the square brackets and the page zooms in on them.
options.text: And made the moon therein a [reflected] light
options.why: The bracket is the whole reveal; one phrase big, one credit line.

options.visual: A real quran.com screenshot with the bracket ringed.
options.why: A real artifact, but site screenshots carry their branding and small type.

lines.line: Arabic mein ye lafz hai hi nahi.

options.visual: The four Arabic words of the moon half, each with its English gloss under it (and made / the moon / in them / a light). The word 'reflected' slides in looking for a place, finds no Arabic word above it, and falls away.
options.text: and made · the moon · in them · a light
options.why: Makes 'not in the Arabic' visible in 1.7 s.

options.visual: '[reflected]' fades out of the line.
options.why: Quicker but weaker.

lines.line: Aur nur ka matlab udhaar ki roshni ho bhi nahi sakta. Quran toh Allah ko bhi nur kehta hai.

options.visual: 'nur ≠ borrowed light' first (borrowed struck by a drawn line on 'udhaar'), then 24:35 words 1–4 in Arabic with 'Allah is the Light of the heavens and the earth.' and نور lit on 'nur kehta hai'.
options.text: Allah is the Light of the heavens and the earth.
options.why: The critics' own point, shown with the verse.

options.visual: Same content stacked.
options.why: Busier.

lines.line: Toh forward galat nikla? Poora nahi. Asli baat nur mein nahi, *siraj* mein hai.

options.visual: The forward returns; on 'galat' it tilts and dims; on 'poora nahi' it stops halfway and slides off. On 'siraj' the word سراج lands huge in amber with the lamp flame behind it.
options.why: The second gap of the reel: there is something real here.

options.visual: 'Not entirely.' in serif then 'siraj'.
options.why: Plainer.

lines.line: Ye lafz poore Quran mein bas *chaar* baar aata hai.

options.visual: Four small lamps in a row, each lighting with its reference (25:61, 33:46, 71:16, 78:13); '4' lands big on 'chaar'.
options.tag: Numerical observation · Quranic Arabic Corpus, root s-r-j
options.why: Counts on screen as it is said.

options.visual: A mushaf-style strip with four highlights.
options.why: Needs a mushaf image with a usable licence.

lines.line: Teen baar suraj ke liye. Ek baar Nabi sallallahu alaihi wasallam. Aur chaand ke liye? *Ek baar bhi nahi*.

options.visual: The four lamps sort: three fly to the Sun (25:61, 71:16, 78:13), one to 'the Prophet ﷺ (33:46)' as type; the Moon's slot stays empty and '0' lands under it on 'ek baar bhi nahi'.
options.sound: tick per lamp, silence for the zero
options.why: The finding of the reel, shown as a count.

options.visual: A three-row tally.
options.why: Reads as a spreadsheet.

lines.line: Aur ye fark sahi baithta hai. Chiragh apna tel jalata hai, suraj apna fuel. Chaand kuch nahi jalata.

options.layout: full-screen real footage, three hard cuts
options.visual: A real oil-lamp flame (free-licence footage) 'burns oil'; NASA SDO footage of the Sun's surface 'burns its own fuel (fusion)'; NASA Moon, cold and grey, 'burns nothing'.
options.text: burns oil / its own fuel / nothing
options.sound: flame crackle, low solar rumble, silence
options.why: Real pictures carry the logic; three hard cuts keep pace.

options.visual: Three icons side by side.
options.why: Icon look, weaker.

lines.line: Haan, chaand ki roshni udhaar ki hai, ye Quran se *hazaar saal* pehle ek Greek shayar likh chuka tha.

options.visual: A free-licence photo of a Parmenides bust; pull quote 'Shining by night with borrowed light' (Burnet), then a timeline line from c. 475 BCE to 610 CE with '≈1,100 years' on 'hazaar saal'.
options.text: Shining by night with borrowed light
options.tag: Historical record · Parmenides, fr. 14 (c. 475 BCE), tr. Burnet
options.sound: paper turn, tick on the timeline
options.why: The honest half of the verdict, with a real face and source.

options.visual: The quote alone.
options.why: No real artifact.

lines.line: Toh Quran ne koi nayi khoj nahi sunayi. Bas wo galti nahi ki, jo bahut aasaan thi.

options.visual: 'Half true.' lands in serif (no stamp). Two lines below: '"Reflected" was added by the translator.' and 'The Sun is a lamp; the Moon is never called one.' On 'galti' the easy mistake appears as type, 'the moon, a lamp', and a drawn line crosses it.
options.why: The verdict, written as an editor would, not a sticker.

options.visual: A true/false meter at half.
options.why: Template tell.

lines.line: Aasmaan mein chiragh ek hi hai. Aur Quran ne chiragh *usi* ko kaha.

options.visual: Wide night sky: the Sun alone in amber, the Moon pale beside it; 'One lamp in the sky.' sets and holds still for 2 s+; on 'usi' سراج rises over the Sun.
options.why: The payoff picture; holds for the last line.

options.visual: Real NASA Sun footage with the line.
options.why: Less clear pairing with the Moon.

lines.line: Agli baar chaand dekho, toh ye yaad rakhna. Follow kar lo.

options.visual: The real full Moon (NASA) rises slowly; Follow animation with real Instagram and Facebook icons, then like and comment icons with 'Which Quran "fact" forward have you seen most?'
options.text: Which Quran 'fact' forward have you seen most?
options.why: Ends on the Moon the viewer will look at tonight.

options.visual: Plain end card.
options.why: Flat.
